highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, and a broad round of managed-layer performance wins.
highlights_body: The release brings Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite bindings, optimizes several hot paths including SKData.SaveTo and GetEncodedText, adds a SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and expands containerized test coverage to Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server.

bullets.lead: Upstream m151 stability fixes applied
bullets.detail: Three rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged into the bundled engine, keeping the renderer aligned with the latest stable Skia.

bullets.lead: Skia updated to milestone m151
bullets.detail: Initial milestone bump to Skia m151 and cgmanifest sync landing the new engine baseline.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings added
bullets.detail: New C# bindings for the Skia Graphite GPU backend, covering Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, giving consumers access to the next-generation Skia rendering engine.

bullets.lead: Async pixel readback for SKImage and SKSurface
bullets.detail: New RequestReadPixels API provides a backend-neutral asynchronous path for reading pixels from both images and surfaces without blocking the GPU pipeline.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing overloads and performance
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse now accepts ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, reducing allocations in parsing hot paths. Hex string parsing was also internally optimized.

bullets.lead: GRContextOptions unsafe modifier removed
bullets.detail: The unnecessary unsafe modifier was dropped from GRContextOptions, which may require minor project configuration updates for consumers using that type in unsafe contexts.

bullets.lead: Binding generation made deterministic across platforms
bullets.detail: The C# binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the platform it runs on, eliminating spurious diffs in generated code.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: A native resource leak in the SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) overload was corrected, preventing memory growth in image-heavy workloads.

bullets.lead: CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create fixed
bullets.detail: A CoTaskMem buffer allocated in the raster failure path of SKImage.Create was not being freed; the leak is now corrected.

bullets.lead: CPU raster regression restored via SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT
bullets.detail: A Skia upstream change disabled the legacy shader context, breaking CPU raster rendering. The flag has been restored to fix the regression.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy
bullets.detail: SaveTo now streams directly from the native buffer instead of copying to a managed array first, halving memory traffic on large blobs.

bullets.lead: Performance: GetEncodedText null-terminated path allocation-free
bullets.detail: The common null-terminated code path in GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing GC pressure in text-heavy rendering loops.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized
bullets.detail: The uniform name-lookup dictionary is now pre-sized to the known uniform count, eliminating resizing overhead for shaders with many uniforms.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKColor/SKColorF conversion ported to managed math
bullets.detail: The SKColor ↔ SKColorF round-trip conversion was moved from a P/Invoke call to managed integer arithmetic, removing interop overhead from a common hot path.

bullets.lead: Performance: SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply ported to managed
bullets.detail: Single-value premultiply and unpremultiply operations are now computed in managed code rather than via native calls.

bullets.lead: Performance: HarfBuzz Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free
bullets.detail: AddUtf8 now encodes strings into a pooled buffer instead of allocating a new byte array on every call.

bullets.lead: Performance: zero-copy spans for SKShaper glyph results
bullets.detail: Glyph result arrays from SKShaper are now read via Span<T> rather than copying to managed arrays, reducing allocation overhead in shaping-heavy workloads.

bullets.lead: Performance: Tag.Parse char[4] allocation removed
bullets.detail: Both HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse now avoid a per-call char[4] array allocation.

bullets.lead: Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build
bullets.detail: The MSVC vcvars environment is now set up once per build job instead of once per target, reducing native build times on Windows.

bullets.lead: Nano Server gains FreeType-backed font support
bullets.detail: Windows Nano Server containers can now render text using the FreeType font backend, which was previously unavailable on that platform.

bullets.lead: New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package
bullets.detail: A new integration package wires the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings directly to SkiaSharp's Vulkan GPU backend, simplifying Vulkan surface setup for Silk.NET users.

bullets.lead: Containerized test legs added: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: The CI matrix now runs the full test suite in Azure Linux, Alpine/musl (for .NET trimming scenarios), and Windows Nano Server containers.

bullets.lead: WebAssembly .NET 11 support with Emscripten 5.0.6
bullets.detail: New Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are included for the .NET 11 WASM target, with exception-handling support via the new exnref ABI.

bullets.lead: Solutions converted to .slnx format
bullets.detail: All Visual Studio solutions have been migrated to the new .slnx XML format for improved tooling compatibility.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Contributed the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, the WebAssembly Skia build fix, and the Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11
contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType font support on Windows Nano Server, enabling text rendering in containerized Windows environments
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Optimized the Windows native build by initializing the MSVC environment once per build rather than once per target

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 milestone update and the WebAssembly build cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the managed-layer performance sprint: allocation-free text encoding, Span-based glyph reads, SKColor math ported to managed, and the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizing.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: RC 1 added the Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, Nano Server font support, the Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and the CoTaskMem and native resource leak fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8, removes the per-call char[4] allocation in Tag.Parse, and bumps the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
